basis: Dmitry authorized this change over Telegram on 2026-09-24. He was asked (29057): may I change policy_check.py (a protected file) so its stale-proof check reads the new digest form of a proof's spec revision, because today it reads that as a number, fails, and treats every factory proof as stale; he answered 'Approved' (29058). The two paths are the protected_paths this commit changes. What they carry is the digest-form reading in spec_revision_stale and nothing else: integer-form proofs are judged exactly as before, and every shape the new reading cannot name for certain stays stale.
